Description
Releases the collected XML data. This method is used when you specify
the
explicit
mode with the
XML::collect
command.
Note: All XML commands are unavailable beginning in v10.
Syntax
XML
::
release
XML::release
Releases the collected XML data.
Examples
when
XML_BEGIN_DOCUMENT
{
XML
::
subscribe
allevent
XML
::
collect
explicit
}
when
XML_BEGIN_ELEMENT
{
log
local0.
"Processing element [XML::element]"
}
when
XML_END_DOCUMENT
{
XML
::
release
}
